about: Anchor nodes of the library's graph: events, organisations, places and days that items connect to. Ids match the ids the main site already uses where one exists (event:web-summit-lisbon-2026, organisation:web-summit), so the two graphs meet at the same anchors. Topic and agent nodes are added by the build from the items.

nodes.label: Web Summit Lisbon 2026
nodes.note: 9 to 12 November 2026, Lisbon. Day Two (Wednesday 11 November) did not take place: Storm Charles, on the Portuguese Government's formal advice.

nodes.label: Day Two, Wednesday 11 November 2026 (cancelled)
nodes.note: Did not take place: Storm Charles. Many sessions moved to Thursday.

nodes.label: Day Three, Thursday 12 November 2026
nodes.note: The final day, with sessions rescheduled from Wednesday.

nodes.label: Storm Charles
nodes.note: The storm that closed Web Summit's Day Two, November 2026.
